definition.name: Move Survey Point Keep Coordinates
definition.description: Moves the survey point (unclipped) to an internal XYZ in metres without changing shared coordinates, rolling back if any location or base point value changes.
definition.aiDescription: Moves the survey point (unclipped) to an internal XYZ in metres without changing shared coordinates, rolling back if any location or base point value changes.
